issue.title: just symvision red: private module sase.instructions._runs imported across files collides with unrelated _runs() helpers
issue.description:
## Symptom

`just symvision` (and the `lint (symvision)` stage of `just check` / `sase tool run check`)
fails on clean master (observed at 66d598d198, 2026-10-06):

```
Error: Private functions/classes should not be imported. Make these public if they need to be imported by non-test files!:
  _runs in src/sase/agents_sync/v2_snapshot_io.py
  _runs in src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/decks/final/overview_card.py
```

`sase tool run check` labels both items KNOWN with "no owner" (witness
05b9fc696a324977dde864aadd60a092 / earlier 48f36c668a00e9661681cf4de3ff932a,
22778c601b3c983292d19516826709e8).

## Root cause (not in the two reported files)

Neither reported file imports anything named `_runs`; each defines and uses its own
file-local `_runs()` helper (overview_card since e75840b0c9, 2026-09-27; v2_snapshot_io
since 231483a25f, 2026-07-28). The trigger is the **private module**
`src/sase/instructions/_runs.py`, imported across files by name:

- `src/sase/instructions/verify.py:9` — `from sase.instructions import _runs as runs`
- `src/sase/instructions/coverage.py:22` — same
- `src/sase/doctor/checks_instructions.py:43,104,149` — `from sase.instructions import _runs as run_mod`
- `src/sase/main/instructions_handler.py:60,308` — same
- tests: `tests/instructions/test_scoreboard_coverage.py`, `tests/instructions/test_verify_cli.py`

Symvision matches the imported name `_runs` against every private def named `_runs` and
blames the two unrelated function defs. The module-import pattern was introduced by E1
(sase-1gu, commit 08c8a56b36 "add observed-mode instruction delivery verifier") and E2
(sase-1h3) added more import sites of the same module.

## Suggested fix

Rename `src/sase/instructions/_runs.py` to a public module name (for example
`sase/instructions/runs.py` or `run_index.py`) and update the import sites above plus
the two test modules. Do not rename the two unrelated `_runs()` helpers or add pragmas.
Optionally report the module-vs-function name collision upstream in `symvision`.

## Provenance

Proposed as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP by every phase of epic sase-1h3 (sase-1h3.1 note #1,
sase-1h3.3 note #1, sase-1h3.4 note #1, sase-1h3.6 note #1, sase-1h3.7 note #1), all
misattributing it to the two reported files; root-caused and filed by the sase-1h3 land
agent.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic: just symvision fails identically on every run at 9e4b9767d2 and 66d598d198 (five independent phase runs plus the land agent's run); the static import graph, not timing, produces it.

issue.creation_reason: Master's symvision gate has been red with KNOWN/no-owner _runs findings that five sase-1h3 phases misattributed to two unrelated files; the land agent traced it to the cross-file import of the private module sase.instructions._runs.
